android.desc:
Inshorts is India’s highest-rated news app that brings you the latest and best stories from national and international sources, all summarized in just 60 words or less. Stay informed without the clutter: no opinions, no extra noise, only facts that matter. Whether it’s government policies, stock market updates, or the latest Bollywood gossip, Inshorts keeps you updated in seconds. Now available in English and Hindi. 

Now browse multiple features with ease.

My Feed 
Short, crisp, and personalized news updates. 
Browse bite-sized 60-word news summaries for quick updates
Tap anytime to read the original full story
Get a feed of stories, videos and updates tailored to your interests

Finance Feed
Get latest Finance and Business news 
See live stock prices as you read news 
Track the latest market insights, top gainers/losers, and company updates
Build your own watchlist for personalized tracking

News Categories 
Explore a wide variety: India, politics, entertainment, business, technology, startups, world, sports, lifestyle, and more
Always get the best from multiple trusted sources

Insights 
Quick explainers that add background and relevance to big stories
Simplify complex topics into bite-sized easy to read insights

Live Cricket Updates and Scores 
Follow the latest match scores, highlights, and news
Instant cricket coverage alongside your daily news

Video Shorts 
Watch video news updates on trending topics
A visual-first way to stay informed on the go

Bookmark and Share
Save stories to read later
Share instantly on WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter, Reddit, Email, and more

Read Offline 
Access saved stories anytime — even without internet

Inshorts is the fastest way to stay updated with current affairs, and is also the perfect companion for preparing for competitive exams like UPSC, CAT, XAT, and government job exams.

Loved by millions:
Google: Best Apps of 2015
Times of India: “Made for India to simplify your life”
Buzzfeed: “Makes Indian student’s life easier”

Read in short, save your time, and never miss what’s happening around you. Download Inshorts today and reinvent the way you read news.

Inshorts requires the following permissions. Your privacy is critical for us and the app never uses photos, videos and other media files, makes calls, sends messages or saves and/or distributes device information.
Photos/Media Files: The app needs access to the device's storage to save the representational images,
